title: pr-review finding and reviewPayload schemas
description: Deterministic shapes used by skills/pr-review/scripts/pr-review.ps1. Semantic analysis stays in the model; this schema only constrains mechanics.

finding.description: One review finding. Only CONFIRMED findings are eligible for inline placement; PLAUSIBLE findings must stay in the summary (as questions), never as inline comments. A Low-severity finding is additionally eligible for inline placement only when it carries a non-empty 'rule' citation; otherwise it too is moved to the summary. A suggestion is rendered as a committable GitHub suggestion fence only when 'suggestion_verified' is true; otherwise it renders as a plain fenced code block. The helper enforces both gates in -BuildPayload.

verdict.description: CONFIRMED = eligible for inline; PLAUSIBLE = summary-only questions.

symbol.description: Optional enclosing symbol (method, type, function) the finding sits in. Line-independent, so it discriminates two identically-worded findings in one file across reruns where the line alone would shift.

context.description: Optional line-independent location context (normalized hunk text) used in place of 'symbol' when no symbol name applies.

hunk_context.description: Normalized text of the enclosing hunk, used as the line-independent discriminator when neither a symbol name nor a shorter context applies.

placement.description: Requested placement. Inline is valid only when verdict is CONFIRMED and a diff location is present.

rule.description: Citation of the explicit repository rule (source path plus the rule text or section) backing this finding. Required for a Low-severity finding to be eligible for inline placement; ignored for other severities.

suggestion.description: Candidate replacement text. Suggestion text containing a fence marker is refused outright.

fix.description: Prose description of the recommended fix. Distinct from suggestion (exact replacement code). Excluded from the inline comment body and from dedupe substance.

suggestion_verified.description: The suggestion block is emitted as a GitHub ```suggestion fence only when this is true, meaning the replacement was checked to be exact, local, and correct at the pinned head; otherwise the text is rendered as a plain fenced code block that cannot be committed with one click.

body.description: Optional pre-rendered inline comment body. When absent, -BuildPayload composes one from severity/category/summary/failure_scenario/suggestion.

repo.description: Optional owner/repo used when fingerprinting outside a workspace context.

pr.description: Optional PR number used when fingerprinting outside a workspace context.

reviewComment.description: Requires either line (single-line) or start_line+line (multi-line). GitHub's line-comment API needs the location expressed as line+side (and start_line+start_side for multi-line ranges), so side is required whenever line is present, and start_side whenever start_line is present; side/start_side must be LEFT or RIGHT when present.

event.description: Always COMMENT. Never APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES.
